Irene C: Quick follow-up from the active/active run: we need a minimal, auditable pattern for billing when traffic shifts across regions.

Vikram S: Finance wants predictability; ops wants to bill real infra. Suggest a per-tenant `billing_policy` with values: home | served | hybrid. Default = home for enterprise tenants.

Hazel P: Techly: edge should emit immutable routing metadata: home_region, exec_region, policy, parent_request_id. Put it into a signed header so collectors can trust it.

Vikram S: Header names proposal: `X-RWI-Home`, `X-RWI-Exec`, `X-RWI-Policy`, `X-RWI-Ts`, `X-RWI-Sig`. Sig = HMAC-SHA256(K, tenant_id|home|exec|ts). K stored in KMS; rotate quarterly.

Irene C: For hybrid, operational rule: first N seconds (default 45s) billed to exec_region (cold-start), remainder to home_region. We'll document N as configurable per-tenant.

Hazel P: Async tasks: copy signed metadata into task payloads and have workers validate on dequeue. Also capture child-subcall regions to allow many->one recon.

Vikram S: Reconciliation sketch: daily job that joins region_costs to enriched logs and applies billing_policy to allocate cost. Output table includes flags: failover, cold_start, manual_override.

Irene C: Compliance: store audit records (home+exec+sig+ts) for retention tiers (12/36/retainer). Legal to confirm for residency customers.

ops-bot: Created ticket #6170: "signed routing headers + billing_policy reconciliation" and assigned to Hazel P.

Irene C: Action items for RFC follow-up: header spec + sig pseudo-code, collector schema change, recon job doc + sample SQL, console UI for policy toggles & events, retention requirements. Owners: Hazel -> edge/collector PR, Vikram -> recon doc, Irene -> RFC update.

Hazel P: Will prototype an envoy filter that signs headers and publishes a small test telemetry stream.

Vikram S: I'll draft reconciliation queries and share.

Irene C: Thanks all. I'll post the RFC patch later today and tag owners.
